h:
使用 Z-Image 创建了超逼真结果的工作流程。虽然我为我的 NiceGirls LoRA 设计了它，但它实际上在没有人的情况下也能很好地工作（如第一张图片所示）。实际上工作流程并未针对速度进行优化，因为我的目标是质量。
你需要下载我的lora：https://civitai.com/models/1862761?modelVersionId=2465980
和自定义节点：https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF
https://github.com/PGCRT/CRT-Nodes（不确定您是否仍然需要这个包来使用 z-image lora 加载器，因为据我了解，在 ComfyUI 的最新版本中，本机 LoRA Loader 已经支持 z-image。）
其实你也可以尝试没有我的lora

o.en:
Created a workflow for ultrarealistic results with Z-Image. While I designed it for my NiceGirls LoRA, it actually works good without people too (like on 1st picture). Actually workflow non-optimized for speed, cause i aimed at quality.
U need to download my lora:https://civitai.com/models/1862761?modelVersionId=2465980
And custom nodes:https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF
https://github.com/PGCRT/CRT-Nodes(not sure if you still need this pack to use z-image lora loader, because as I understand it, in the latest versions of ComfyUI the native LoRA Loader already supports z-image.)
Actually you can try without my lora too
